nodes.label: Kothagolp
nodes.rationale: Free open-source Android novel reader; heavily extended fork of Novery expanding to 19 built-in providers because the upstream provided UI foundation and core architecture worth reusing rather than rebuilding.

nodes.label: Novery
nodes.rationale: Upstream base app: reader, TTS, recommendation engine, theming system, and overall architecture originate here.

nodes.label: Komikku
nodes.rationale: Inspiration for storage folder structure and periodic backup system.

nodes.label: Multi-Source Reader Architecture
nodes.rationale: App aggregates 19 third-party novel sources instead of hosting content; concept pioneered by Tachiyomi, extensible source architecture inspired by LNReader.

nodes.label: Google Drive Cloud Backup and Sync
nodes.norm_label: google drive cloud backup and sync

nodes.label: Book Recommendation Engine
nodes.rationale: Originated in Novery; Kothagolp adds genre-tag based recommendation on top.

nodes.label: Content Aggregator Disclaimer
nodes.rationale: App positioned as search engine/aggregator that hosts no content, shifting legal responsibility for content to third-party website operators; justifies the crawl-and-display design over hosting.

nodes.label: Adding a Novel Source Process
nodes.rationale: New sources plug in by extending a single base class and registering centrally, keeping source addition a bounded, template-driven contribution.

nodes.label: MainProvider Base Class
nodes.rationale: Contract for every source: search(), loadMainPage(), loadNovelDetails(), loadChapterContent().

nodes.label: Build Workflow
nodes.rationale: CI on push/PR to main; missing Google OAuth secret is tolerated (sync disabled) because debug builds need not ship sync.

nodes.label: Release Workflow
nodes.rationale: Tag-triggered (v*) or manual dispatch; hard-fails if Google OAuth secret is missing because production builds must not ship with sync disabled.

nodes.label: Google OAuth client_secrets.json Injection
nodes.rationale: Base64 secret decoded into app/src/main/assets/client_secrets.json at build time so Drive sync credentials never live in the repo.

nodes.label: Release Keystore Signing
nodes.rationale: Keystore decoded from base64 secret and keystore.properties generated at build time, keeping signing material out of the repo.

nodes.label: ABI-Split APK Release Assets
nodes.rationale: Per-ABI APKs (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64) plus a universal fallback are renamed with versionName parsed from app/build.gradle.kts, so users download smaller device-matched binaries.

nodes.label: AI Recommendations via OpenRouter
nodes.rationale: Bring-your-own OpenRouter API key unlocks AI picks; personalized picks skipped with no reading history to avoid empty recommendations; model switch bypasses error cooldown so a new model always gets an immediate attempt.

nodes.label: Bug Report Template
nodes.rationale: Requires app version, Android version, device, and reproduction steps up front — the fields an Android multi-device bug triage needs.

nodes.label: Pull Request Template
nodes.rationale: Includes a dedicated 'New novel source' change type, reflecting that source contributions are a first-class, expected PR category.
